title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: A closed-loop reinforcement learning framework for rapid compound directed optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) holds transformative potential for drug discovery, yet existing architectures typically operate in open loops without experimental feedback. Here we introduce rapid compound directed optimization (RCDO), a closed-loop reinforcement learning framework that accelerates the optimization process by bridging dry-lab computation with wet-lab feedback. RCDO couples a three-dimensional structure-guided generative model with a multi-level reward system updated after each design cycle using experimental measurements from all synthesized compounds, including inactive or developability-failed compounds. By continuously aligning the generative model with accumulated wet-lab measurements, RCDO substantially compresses optimization timelines. We evaluated RCDO through retrospective benchmarking against historical optimization trajectories and prospective wet-lab campaigns targeting ROR1, NLRP3, and NSD3. Across prospective evaluations, RCDO rapidly resolved key optimization bottlenecks within two to three design cycles: improving the oral exposure of an ROR1 inhibitor by 40-fold while maintaining antitumor efficacy, reducing CYP2C19 inhibition of an NLRP3 antagonist by 20-fold while preserving inflammasome activity, and boosting the binding affinity of an NSD3 hit by 18-fold. By directly coupling wet-lab feedback to generative learning, RCDO establishes an efficient platform for compound directed optimization, transforming AI-driven drug discovery from static generation into continuous experimental adaptation.
items.summary_zh: RCDO 将三维结构引导生成模型与强化学习结合，并在每轮设计后用全部已合成化合物的实验结果更新多层奖励函数。作者在 ROR1、NLRP3 和 NSD3 三个前瞻性湿实验项目中报告，分别实现 ROR1 抑制剂口服暴露提高 40 倍、NLRP3 拮抗剂 CYP2C19 抑制降低 20 倍，以及 NSD3 先导物结合亲和力提高 18 倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是少见地把失败化合物也纳入学习信号的实验反馈生成式优化案例，直接对应药物化学中的多参数优化。摘要未给出各项目的样本量、对照设计和完整可开发性数据，跨靶点可推广性仍需审阅全文。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）在药物发现中具有变革性潜力，但现有架构通常在没有实验反馈的开放环路中运行。我们在此提出快速化合物定向优化（rapid compound directed optimization，RCDO），这是一种通过连接干实验室计算与湿实验反馈来加速优化过程的闭环强化学习框架。RCDO 将三维结构引导的生成模型与多层奖励系统耦合；该奖励系统在每个设计周期后使用所有已合成化合物的实验测量结果更新，其中包括无活性或可开发性失败的化合物。通过使生成模型持续与累积的湿实验测量结果对齐，RCDO 大幅压缩了优化时间线。我们通过针对历史优化轨迹的回顾性基准测试，以及针对 ROR1、NLRP3 和 NSD3 的前瞻性湿实验项目评估了 RCDO。在前瞻性评估中，RCDO 在两到三个设计周期内迅速解决了关键优化瓶颈：在保持抗肿瘤疗效的同时，将 ROR1 抑制剂的口服暴露提高 40 倍；在保持炎性小体活性的同时，将 NLRP3 拮抗剂对 CYP2C19 的抑制降低 20 倍；并将 NSD3 命中物的结合亲和力提高 18 倍。通过把湿实验反馈直接耦合到生成式学习中，RCDO 建立了一个高效的化合物定向优化平台，将 AI 驱动的药物发现从静态生成转变为持续的实验适应。
items.author_line: Wang, H., Lu, D., Lyu, W., Xiu, S., Shi, C., Zhou, X., Xi, B., Feng, W., Xiao, Y., Chen, Y., Zhang, H., Li, Q., Huang, B., Liu, Z.

items.title: Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.
items.summary_zh: Packora 是一个流式生成分子晶体结构预测模型，可从分子图联合预测原子坐标与晶格，并处理多组分和有机金属晶体。作者将生成与排序分开评估，报告其在六项生成基准上取得最佳同预算覆盖率，同时提高实验晶型恢复率、降低实验晶型排名并加快排序收敛。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 晶型直接影响药物、农化品和有机电子材料的性质；联合生成坐标和晶格是有价值的建模路线。证据主要来自基准及既有实验晶型的恢复，摘要尚不足以判断其对未知化学空间和实际晶化条件的表现。
items.abstract_zh: 分子晶体结构预测（CSP）对于药物、农用化学品和有机电子学非常重要，在这些领域，分子构象和堆积的细微差异可强烈影响材料性质。我们提出 Packora，一种用于分子 CSP 的流式生成模型，它从分子图联合预测原子坐标和晶格。Packora 支持多组分和有机金属晶体，并可在单一模型内以分子构象、立体化学标签和空间群信息的任意子集作为条件。受 CCDC CSP 盲测启发，我们将生成和排序分开评估：用生成来分离生成器质量，用排序在共同的弛豫和排序流程下测量端到端性能。我们还系统研究了架构、训练、条件化、推理和扩展，确定了一种有效设计，其基础是可缓存的成对推理、训练目标和数值求解器选择、条件化 dropout，以及成对表示与单体表示的平衡扩展。Packora 在结构生成和排序基准上均优于基线，在全部六项生成基准上取得最佳的同预算覆盖率，并实现更高的实验晶型恢复率、更低的实验晶型排名和更快的排序收敛。
items.author_line: Nayoung Kim, Kiyoung Seong, Sungsoo Ahn

items.title: Cross-Scale Assessment of MACE Foundation Models and from Scratch Trained Potentials for Bi-Pt Systems
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer a computationally efficient alternative to first-principles methods for atomistic simulations, but their performance beyond the configurations represented in their training data remains difficult to assess. Here, we benchmark four pretrained MACE foundation models (MP-0b3, MPA, OMAT, and MATPES) against two MACE potentials trained specifically on Bi-Pt configurations . The models are first evaluated for structural relaxation and vibrational properties of a Bi18Pt24 nanocage using DFT as a reference. The best-performing foundation model, OMAT, is then assessed at the bulk scale for the equilibrium structure, phonon dispersion, and melting behaviour of NiAs-type BiPt. All four pretrained models reproduce the DFT nanocage structure with sub-Å RMSD values of 0.059–0.089 Å, whereas the models trained from scratch give substantially larger deviations of 0.289 Å and 0.463 Å for the 1000 and 6000 models, respectively. The pretrained models also reproduce the main features of the DFT vibrational spectral distribution, with OMAT showing the closest quantitative agreement. In contrast, increasing the scratch-training set from 1000 to 6000 substantially reduces energy and force errors but does not improve structural accuracy for the nanocage. For bulk BiPt, OMAT predicts lattice parameters within 1.15% of experiment and reproduces the DFT phonon dispersion with an overall frequency RMSE of 11.62 cm−1. Two-phase coexistence simulations give a melting temperature of 1083±38 K, compared with the experimental value of 1038 K. These results show that pretrained MACE models can provide accurate structural and dynamical predictions for the Bi-Pt systems examined here despite the limited representation of Bi-Pt in the Materials Project and OMat24 datasets. The comparison also shows that conventional energy and force errors alone do not necessarily predict performance outside the systemspecific training domain. Structural, vibrational, and finite-temperature benchmarks therefore provide complementary measures for assessing the generalization of MLIPs across chemical environments and length scales.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 Bi-Pt 纳米笼和块体 BiPt 上比较四个预训练 MACE 基础模型与两个从头训练势能模型，并以 DFT 和实验为参照。OMAT 对块体晶格参数的预测在实验值 1.15% 以内，双相共存模拟给出 1083±38 K 的熔点，接近 1038 K 的实验值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作以结构、振动和有限温度性质而非仅能量与力误差来检验机器学习原子间势的迁移能力，给材料模拟提供了更严格的评估思路。结论目前局限于 Bi-Pt 体系，且作为预印本仍需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）为原子尺度模拟提供了计算效率更高的第一性原理方法替代方案，但它们在训练数据所表示构型之外的性能仍难以评估。我们在此将四个预训练 MACE 基础模型（MP-0b3、MPA、OMAT 和 MATPES）与两个专门在 Bi-Pt 构型上训练的 MACE 势进行基准比较。首先以 DFT 为参考，评估这些模型对 Bi18Pt24 纳米笼的结构弛豫和振动性质。随后，在块体尺度上评估表现最佳的基础模型 OMAT 对 NiAs 型 BiPt 的平衡结构、声子色散和熔化行为的预测。四个预训练模型均以 0.059–0.089 Å 的亚埃 RMSD 重现 DFT 纳米笼结构，而从头训练的模型在 1000 和 6000 模型下分别给出明显更大的 0.289 Å 和 0.463 Å 偏差。预训练模型也重现了 DFT 振动光谱分布的主要特征，其中 OMAT 显示出最接近的定量一致性。相比之下，将从头训练集从 1000 增加到 6000 会大幅降低能量和力误差，却不会提高纳米笼的结构精度。对于块体 BiPt，OMAT 预测的晶格参数与实验相差在 1.15% 以内，并以 11.62 cm−1 的总体频率 RMSE 重现 DFT 声子色散。双相共存模拟给出的熔化温度为 1083±38 K，而实验值为 1038 K。这些结果表明，尽管 Bi-Pt 在 Materials Project 和 OMat24 数据集中的表征有限，预训练 MACE 模型仍能为这里考察的 Bi-Pt 体系提供准确的结构和动力学预测。该比较还表明，常规的能量和力误差本身不一定能预测模型在特定体系训练域之外的表现。因此，结构、振动和有限温度基准为评估 MLIPs 在不同化学环境和长度尺度上的泛化能力提供了互补指标。
items.author_line: Quang-Phuc Ngo, Minh-Tue Truong, Dominik Domin, Jonathan Balde, Raphaël Vangheluwe, Carine Clavaguéra, Mihai-Cosmin Marinica, Nguyen-Thi Van-Oanh

items.title: NELLY enables patient-centric drug prioritization through interpretable drug-conditioned gene weighting
items.abstract_or_text: Precision oncology seeks to match each tumor with the most effective anti-cancer therapy. Advances in pharmacogenomics and machine learning enabled drug response prediction models with strong performance in cancer cell lines. Nonetheless, patient-centric evaluation of drug prioritization and systematic assessment of model generalization in patient-derived systems across cancer types remain largely absent. Here we introduce a translational framework combining patient-centric benchmarking with a pan-cancer pharmacogenomic atlas of patient-derived organoids, together with NELLY, a deep learning model integrating transcriptomic and chemical information to predict drug response and prioritize therapies. NELLY outperformed existing methods for patient-specific drug prioritization across cancer cell lines and patient-derived organoids, including under out-of-distribution evaluation. Its dynamic weighting mechanism provided patient-specific gene attributions, offering a route to connect predicted drug response to molecular programs associated with drug resistance. Our results support NELLY as a promising framework for translationally relevant and interpretable drug response prediction in precision oncology.
items.summary_zh: NELLY 将转录组与化学信息整合，以可随药物变化的基因权重预测药物反应并进行患者级治疗排序。作者结合泛癌患者来源类器官药物基因组图谱开展评估，称其在细胞系、类器官及分布外测试中优于现有方法，并可给出患者特异的基因归因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 患者来源类器官和可解释归因使药物反应模型更接近转化肿瘤学应用，也有助于提出耐药机制假设。模型表现是否能转化为临床获益尚未在摘要中得到证明。
items.abstract_zh: 精准肿瘤学旨在为每个肿瘤匹配最有效的抗癌治疗。药物基因组学和机器学习的进展已使药物反应预测模型在癌细胞系中取得强劲表现。然而，以患者为中心的药物优先排序评估，以及对模型在跨癌种患者来源系统中泛化能力的系统评估，仍在很大程度上缺失。我们在此提出一个转化框架，将以患者为中心的基准测试与患者来源类器官的泛癌药物基因组图谱相结合，并提出 NELLY——一个整合转录组和化学信息以预测药物反应并优先排序疗法的深度学习模型。NELLY 在癌细胞系和患者来源类器官中针对患者特异药物优先排序的表现均优于现有方法，其中包括在分布外评估下。其动态加权机制提供患者特异的基因归因，为将预测的药物反应与耐药相关分子程序联系起来提供了一条途径。我们的结果支持 NELLY 作为精准肿瘤学中具有转化相关性且可解释的药物反应预测框架。
items.author_line: Peralta Viteri, C., Harnischfeger, N., Szabo, L., Hartmann, S., Kretzschmar, K.

items.title: AgentFold: Closed-Loop Agentic Search for Protein Folding Model Design
items.abstract_or_text: Scientific LLM agents have shown promise in literature reasoning, tool use, and experiment planning, but it remains unclear whether they can autonomously improve large, tightly coupled scientific machine-learning systems through executable code changes and computationally expensive validation. We study this question in protein folding, where progress requires coordinated architectural modifications, multi-objective evaluation, and domain-aware interpretation. We present AgentFold, a multi-agent framework that formulates folding-model development as a closed-loop search over executable code variants. Starting from ESMFold, AgentFold proposes hypotheses, implements and debugs code-level modifications, evaluates model variants, analyzes experimental outcomes, and stores both successful and failed interventions in structured memory. An MCTS-style policy allocates computational resources across high-scoring search branches. On an engineering-scale protein-folding codebase comprising more than 2,000 lines of code, AgentFold explores approximately 80 model variants using approximately 5,000 GPU-hours and 170 million LLM tokens. Under a matched computational budget, AgentFold improves the best lDDT by 7.5% over independent Codex proposals and outperforms a random-search control. Beyond model improvement, the resulting intervention traces reveal recurring empirical design patterns: stable gains tend to arise from early, soft, learnable priors and gated refinement, whereas direct geometric perturbations and geometry-conditioned feedback often destabilize training. The code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/lmqfly/AgentFold.
items.summary_zh: AgentFold 将 ESMFold 的开发表述为对可执行代码变体的多智能体闭环搜索：提出假设、修改和调试代码、评估模型、分析结果，并记录成功与失败干预。在逾 2,000 行的蛋白折叠代码库上，其探索约 80 个变体，使用约 5,000 GPU 小时和 1.7 亿 LLM tokens；同等预算下，最佳 lDDT 比独立 Codex 提案高 7.5%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把智能体的作用从调用既有结构预测器推进到可审计地搜索模型设计，并报告了强计算预算下的对照。计算成本很高，且结果仅围绕一个代码库和起始模型，尚不能说明广泛的自动化科研能力。
items.abstract_zh: 科学 LLM 智能体已在文献推理、工具使用和实验规划中显示出前景，但它们能否通过可执行代码改动和计算代价高昂的验证，自主改进大型、紧密耦合的科学机器学习系统，仍不清楚。我们在蛋白质折叠中研究这一问题；该领域的进展需要协调的架构修改、多目标评估和领域感知解释。我们提出 AgentFold，这是一个多智能体框架，将折叠模型开发表述为对可执行代码变体的闭环搜索。AgentFold 从 ESMFold 出发，提出假设、实现并调试代码层面的修改、评估模型变体、分析实验结果，并在结构化记忆中存储成功和失败的干预。一个 MCTS 风格策略在高评分搜索分支之间分配计算资源。在一个包含超过 2,000 行代码的工程规模蛋白质折叠代码库上，AgentFold 探索了约 80 个模型变体，使用约 5,000 GPU 小时和 1.7 亿 LLM tokens。在匹配的计算预算下，AgentFold 相比独立 Codex 提案将最佳 lDDT 提高 7.5%，并优于随机搜索对照。除模型改进外，所得干预轨迹还揭示了反复出现的经验设计模式：稳定增益往往来自早期、柔和且可学习的先验与门控细化，而直接几何扰动和几何条件反馈常会破坏训练稳定性。代码和实验资源已在 https://github.com/lmqfly/AgentFold 公开。
items.author_line: Mingquan Liu, Jiangyu Chen, Hanqun Cao, Xujun Zhang, Pengsen Ma, Xiangru Tang, Shuting Jin, Zhuo Yang, Tianfan Fu, Fang Wu, Xiangxiang Zeng

items.title: Site-Resolved Prediction of Mayr Nucleophilicity with Reactivity-Pretrained Graph Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: The magnitude of a compound’s nucleophilicity is pivotal to mechanistic studies and rational catalyst design. Over the past decades, Mayr and co-workers developed an invaluable framework for quantifying nucleophilicity, comprising N parameters. Nevertheless, achieving accurate nucleophilic site prediction and low-cost quantification remains a formidable challenge. Herein, we construct a nucleophilicity prediction model, termed PPGNS (Pretrained and Physicochemical feature–augmented Graph neural network model for joint Nucleophilicity and Site prediction). By integrating carefully designed physicochemical and physical organic descriptors and extended tight-binding (xTB) calculations, graph neural networks (GNN) are employed to predict the N parameters, with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) adopted for mechanistic interpretation. The PPGNS model achieves a higher accuracy and efficiency performance for N prediction relative to previous benchmark studies, with R 2 of 0.94 and 0.95 for automatic-site and known-site evaluations, both from pooled (out of fold) OOF predictions across five outer folds. Most notably, PPGNS enables site-resolved nucleophilicity prediction, achieving 93% Top-1 and 98% Top-3 recovery of nucleophilic reaction sites, a capability not reported in previous studies.
items.summary_zh: PPGNS 以物理化学和物理有机描述符、xTB 计算及图神经网络，联合预测 Mayr 亲核性 N 参数和亲核反应位点，并用 SHAP 作机制解释。五折外层汇总预测中，自动位点和已知位点评估的 R² 分别为 0.94 和 0.95，位点预测达到 93% Top-1、98% Top-3。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 能同时预测反应位点和可量化亲核性，有望服务于机理研究与催化剂设计；报告了清晰的交叉验证指标。所涉反应空间、外部测试集和 xTB 成本对实际应用的影响仍需通过全文判断。
items.abstract_zh: 化合物亲核性的大小对于机理研究和理性催化剂设计至关重要。过去数十年间，Mayr 及其同事开发了一个用于量化亲核性的宝贵框架，其中包括 N 参数。尽管如此，实现准确的亲核位点预测和低成本量化仍是一项艰巨挑战。我们在此构建了一个亲核性预测模型，称为 PPGNS（用于联合亲核性和位点预测的预训练并融入物理化学特征的图神经网络模型）。通过整合精心设计的物理化学与物理有机描述符以及扩展紧束缚（xTB）计算，采用图神经网络（GNN）预测 N 参数，并采用 SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）进行机制解释。相较既有基准研究，PPGNS 模型在 N 预测中实现了更高的准确性和效率；在五个外层折叠上汇总的 OOF 预测中，自动位点和已知位点评估的 R² 分别为 0.94 和 0.95。最值得注意的是，PPGNS 实现了位点分辨的亲核性预测，对亲核反应位点达到 93% 的 Top-1 和 98% 的 Top-3 恢复率；这是一项既往研究未报告的能力。
items.author_line: Shangkun Shi, Junliang He, Zikang Dong, Zhaoyang Li, Shaoguang Zhang

items.title: Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation
items.abstract_or_text: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through de novo generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology. We introduce MAELLE (MechAnistic Edit fLow-matching on eLectron rEarrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors. Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites. To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations. MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models. Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade. Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.
items.summary_zh: MAELLE 不直接生成产物分子或启发式编辑分子图，而是在成键、非键和氢位点定义的图结构整数电子占据空间上以 CTMC 进行离散流匹配。该方法用最优传输构造无需基元步骤标注的可解释电子重排编辑轨迹，并在 USPTO-480K 及两类分布外测试中报告有竞争力的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将反应预测重述为电子重排，有望同时改善可解释性、机理轨迹恢复和副产物预测。摘要只称性能“有竞争力”，未提供准确率和机理标注的定量验证，需谨慎看待优越性。
items.abstract_zh: 化学反应从根本上说是电子空间中的转化，但大多数机器学习方法要么通过从头生成产物分子进行建模，要么通过直接作用于分子拓扑的启发式图编辑进行建模。我们引入 MAELLE（MechAnistic Edit fLow-matching on eLectron rEarrangements），它转而将反应建模为电子占据向量上的离散流匹配。具体而言，我们将反应物到产物的映射表述为一个连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），其定义在所有成键、非键和氢位点上的图结构整数值电子占据空间中。为构建中间编辑轨迹，我们利用最优传输将离散流匹配混合路径推广至离散电子重排，从而无需基元步骤标注即可得到一系列具有机理可解释性的编辑动作。与领先的反应预测模型相比，MAELLE 在 USPTO-480K 基准上实现了有竞争力的性能。除分布内准确性外，我们还在两个分布外设置——结构复杂性和反应类型——中评估了鲁棒性，发现 MAELLE 在现有方法性能下降的情况下仍保持强劲表现。最后，由于学习到的流在完整电子再分布上运行，MAELLE 能自然恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹，并能预测反应副产物。
items.author_line: Nguyen Xuan-Vu, Octavian Susanu, Daniel Armstrong, Philippe Schwaller

items.title: SmartReact: An Open-Source Python Package for Scalable Forward Synthesis Enumeration Built on Interpretable SMARTS Templates
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting which products can be made from a set of building blocks underpins library design, analogue generation, and synthesis-constrained generative modelling. Reaction templates encoded as SMARTS patterns are the standard tool for this forward synthesis enumeration task. However, existing approaches force a trade-off between chemical coverage, specificity, and the computational cost of applying large template sets at scale. We present SmartReact, an open-source Python library whose template set inverts that trade-off, because the construction that produces the specificity is the same construction that makes the templates cheap to eliminate. Its templates are combinatorial expansions over SMARTS-RX, a fixed hierarchical functional group ontology of 406 patterns, so the library exposes only a few hundred distinct reactant-side patterns no matter how many templates it holds, and one classification per molecule resolves thousands of templates at once. Every prediction of SmartReact is traceable to a named reaction and an explicit set of functional group requirements, making results directly interpretable by chemists and straightforward to audit. New reaction types can be incorporated by specifying a SMARTS pattern and its functional group requirements, making the library easy to extend. A case study enumerating 536,171 unique products from 1,000 building blocks in 15.7 s demonstrates real-world utility at scale. Scientific Contribution: SmartReact contributes a large, expert-refined SMARTS reaction template library together with an open-source Python package designed to use it efficiently. The library's 9,770 templates spanning 37 medicinal chemistry reaction types are generated by combinatorial expansion over the SMARTS-RX functional group ontology, which gives them a chemical specificity and non-redundancy that auto-extracted libraries lack and, at the same time, a bounded reactant-side pattern space that makes them cheap to pre-filter.
items.summary_zh: SmartReact 是开源 Python 正向合成枚举库，基于 SMARTS-RX 的 406 个层级官能团模式组合扩展出 9,770 个模板，覆盖 37 类药物化学反应。作者称从 1,000 个砌块枚举 536,171 个唯一产物仅需 15.7 s，且每项预测都可追溯至命名反应和明确的官能团要求。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可解释、可扩展的反应模板库可用于化合物库设计、类似物生成及合成约束生成模型。摘要未给出化学有效率、适用范围或与其他枚举器的系统对比，速度主张应结合完整基准评估。
items.abstract_zh: 从一组砌块预测能够制备哪些产物，是化合物库设计、类似物生成和受合成约束生成建模的基础。以 SMARTS 模式编码的反应模板是这项正向合成枚举任务的标准工具。然而，现有方法迫使人们在化学覆盖度、特异性和大规模应用大量模板集的计算成本之间权衡。我们提出 SmartReact，这是一个开源 Python 库，其模板集颠倒了这一权衡，因为产生特异性的构建方式也使模板能够被低成本排除。其模板是基于 SMARTS-RX 的组合扩展；SMARTS-RX 是包含 406 个模式的固定层级官能团本体。因此，无论其持有多少模板，该库都只暴露数百个不同的反应物侧模式，而一次分子分类即可同时解析数千个模板。SmartReact 的每项预测都可追溯至一个命名反应和一组明确的官能团要求，使结果能被化学家直接解释并易于审计。通过指定一个 SMARTS 模式及其官能团要求即可纳入新反应类型，使该库易于扩展。一个从 1,000 个砌块中在 15.7 s 内枚举 536,171 个唯一产物的案例研究展示了其大规模实际效用。科学贡献：SmartReact 提供一个大型、经专家细化的 SMARTS 反应模板库，以及一个旨在高效使用该库的开源 Python 包。该库的 9,770 个模板覆盖 37 类药物化学反应，由 SMARTS-RX 官能团本体上的组合扩展生成；这既赋予其自动提取库所缺乏的化学特异性和非冗余性，也同时提供了有界的反应物侧模式空间，使其能被低成本预筛选。
items.author_line: Fabian P. Krüger, Thierry Kogej, Mikhail Kabeshov, Ola Engkvist, Igor V. Tetko

items.title: UTR-Diffusion: Conditional Diffusion Modeling for Multi-objective and Constrained UTR Design
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation: The 5-prime untranslated region (UTR) and the start-codon-proximal region of the coding sequence (CDS) jointly influence translation efficiency and local RNA secondary-structure stability, while synonymous codon choices throughout the CDS shape codon adaptation. Because the encoded protein is often predetermined, practical mRNA design must coordinate these quantitative objectives while preserving specified nucleotide sequences and amino-acid identities. Existing generative approaches typically address continuous-valued targeting, explicit sequence constraints, and codon-usage control separately rather than integrating all three within a single model. Results: We present UTR-Diffusion, a diffusion-based framework for 5-prime UTR and 5-prime UTR-CDS junction design. UTR-Diffusion conditions generation on continuous-valued MRL and MFE targets and supports nucleotide-level constraints, amino-acid-level constraints with synonymous-codon flexibility, and codon-adaptiveness control that modulates the sequence-level codon adaptation index (CAI). Systematic evaluations across dense MRL-MFE target grids showed that generated distributions shifted consistently with both targets, retained substantial diversity, and strictly preserved specified nucleotide sequences and amino-acid identities. Codon-adaptiveness control yielded distinct, monotonically ordered CAI levels that closely followed the specified adaptiveness targets. In comparative benchmarks, UTR-Diffusion outperformed representative existing methods in high-MRL optimization and precise MRL targeting for 5-prime UTR design, and achieved higher MRL, less-negative junction MFE, and higher CAI than peptide-preserving baselines in 50-nt 5-prime UTR-CDS junction design.
items.summary_zh: UTR-Diffusion 是用于 5-prime UTR 及其与 CDS 连接区设计的条件扩散模型，可同时以 MRL、MFE、核苷酸约束、氨基酸约束和 CAI 为条件。密集目标网格和比较基准显示，生成序列随 MRL/MFE 目标稳定变化，严格保持指定序列和蛋白身份，并在多项优化指标上优于代表性基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型把 mRNA 设计中常彼此割裂的翻译效率、二级结构、编码约束和密码子适应性统一到一个生成框架。结果主要是计算设计评估，尚未显示合成 mRNA 的细胞或动物实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 动机：5-prime 非翻译区（UTR）和编码序列（CDS）中靠近起始密码子的区域共同影响翻译效率和局部 RNA 二级结构稳定性，而贯穿 CDS 的同义密码子选择塑造密码子适应性。由于编码蛋白通常预先确定，实用的 mRNA 设计必须在保留指定核苷酸序列和氨基酸身份的同时协调这些定量目标。现有生成方法通常分别处理连续值目标、显式序列约束和密码子使用控制，而不是在单一模型中整合三者。结果：我们提出 UTR-Diffusion，这是一种用于 5-prime UTR 和 5-prime UTR-CDS 连接区设计的扩散框架。UTR-Diffusion 以连续值 MRL 和 MFE 目标作为生成条件，并支持核苷酸水平约束、具有同义密码子灵活性的氨基酸水平约束，以及调节序列层面密码子适应指数（CAI）的密码子适应性控制。在密集 MRL-MFE 目标网格上的系统评估显示，生成的分布随两个目标一致地移动，保留了显著多样性，并严格保留指定的核苷酸序列和氨基酸身份。密码子适应性控制产生了彼此不同且单调有序的 CAI 水平，并紧密遵循指定的适应性目标。在比较基准中，UTR-Diffusion 在 5-prime UTR 设计的高 MRL 优化和精确 MRL 定位方面优于有代表性的现有方法；在 50-nt 5-prime UTR-CDS 连接区设计中，相比保持肽序列的基线，取得更高 MRL、更不负的连接区 MFE 和更高 CAI。

items.title: TaHL-PTM: Post-Translational Modification Prediction in Proteins via Target-Hooked Discriminative Fine-Tuning of Decoder-only Protein Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) regulate protein function, making accurate residue-level PTM prediction essential for understanding cellular mechanisms and disease pathways. While decoder-only protein language models (PLMs) pretrained with the causal language modeling (CLM) objective have driven breakthroughs across various bioinformatics tasks, their potential for PTM prediction remains largely underexplored. CLM-based PLMs that rely on Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) for tokenization, such as ProtGPT2, introduce intra-token label collision by merging multiple amino acids with conflicting labels into a single token, creating a major bottleneck for residue-level tasks. To overcome this, we propose TaHL-PTM (Target-Hooked Low-rank adaptation for PTM prediction), a novel framework that integrates target-hooked tokenization with site-directed discriminative LoRA fine-tuning. Target-hooked tokenization constrains tokenization around the candidate residue using dedicated marker tokens to eliminate intra-token label collision while preserving the surrounding sequence context, whereas the proposed discriminative objective repurposes the standard generative CLM objective for residue-level PTM classification by directly optimizing the separation between modified and unmodified sites. We benchmark TaHL-PTM across six distinct PTM tasks on ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 models. TaHL-PTM consistently improves MCC, with the largest gain of up to +0.11 for tyrosine phosphorylation (0.34 to 0.45), alongside improvements in F1, AUROC, and AUPR. Performance gains are more pronounced for collision-affected samples, validating the effectiveness of target-hooked tokenization, while consistent improvements across both BPE-based and per-residue-based causal PLMs demonstrate that the proposed framework generalizes across models with different pretraining tokenization schemes.
items.summary_zh: TaHL-PTM 通过在候选残基周围使用 target-hooked tokenization，避免 BPE 蛋白语言模型将标签冲突的多个氨基酸合并到同一 token；再以判别式 LoRA 优化修饰与未修饰位点的分离。在 ProtGPT2 和 ProGen2 的六项 PTM 任务中，最大 MCC 增益为酪氨酸磷酸化的 +0.11（0.34 至 0.45）。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作精确定位了因 BPE 分词带来的残基级标签冲突，并给出兼容多种因果蛋白语言模型的修复方法。证据为任务基准，尚未证明预测可直接替代实验 PTM 鉴定。
items.abstract_zh: 翻译后修饰（PTMs）调控蛋白质功能，因此准确的残基级 PTM 预测对于理解细胞机制和疾病通路至关重要。尽管以因果语言建模（CLM）目标预训练的仅解码器蛋白语言模型（PLMs）已推动多种生物信息学任务取得突破，但其用于 PTM 预测的潜力仍很少被探索。依赖 Byte-Pair Encoding（BPE）分词的 CLM 型 PLM，例如 ProtGPT2，会将具有冲突标签的多个氨基酸合并到单个 token 中，从而引入 token 内标签冲突，成为残基级任务的主要瓶颈。为克服这一问题，我们提出 TaHL-PTM（用于 PTM 预测的 Target-Hooked 低秩适配），这是一个整合 target-hooked 分词与位点定向判别式 LoRA 微调的新框架。Target-hooked 分词利用专用标记 token 将候选残基周围的分词加以约束，在保留周围序列上下文的同时消除 token 内标签冲突；所提出的判别式目标则通过直接优化已修饰和未修饰位点之间的分离，将标准生成式 CLM 目标重新用于残基级 PTM 分类。我们在 ProtGPT2 和 ProGen2 模型上、跨六项不同 PTM 任务对 TaHL-PTM 进行了基准测试。TaHL-PTM 持续改善 MCC，其中酪氨酸磷酸化的最大增益达到 +0.11（0.34 至 0.45），同时 F1、AUROC 和 AUPR 也有所提高。受冲突影响的样本中性能增益更明显，验证了 target-hooked 分词的有效性；而在基于 BPE 及基于每残基的因果 PLM 上均有一致改善，表明所提框架能泛化至具有不同预训练分词方案的模型。
items.author_line: Prasain, B., Pratyush, P., Schulze, S., KC, D. B.

items.title: RegimeFormer: A Large Protein Model of Global Perturbation Regimes
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models organize sequence and structure at scale, but a global representation of how proteins respond to mutation remains lacking. We present RegimeFormer, a large protein perturbation model coupled to RegimeAtlas, constructed by harmonizing and indexing 202,556,313 non-redundant protein sequences across the tree of life. A diversity-preserving one-million-protein subset provides the high-resolution training and inference layer, with 995,995 proteins yielding residue-level summaries across 407,048,356 residues and substitution-specific predictions available on demand. Across experimental deep mutational scanning, molecular benchmarks, structural confidence and evolutionary constraint, RegimeFormer identifies reproducible protein-level perturbation regimes that organize residue fragility, adaptability and predictive uncertainty. Regime conditioning improves substitution-specific prediction, with the largest relative gains under unseen-protein, unseen-family and low-homology evaluation. RegimeFormer-derived molecular priors further improve downstream transcriptomic and drug-response modelling. Together, RegimeFormer and RegimeAtlas provide a scalable framework for mapping, predicting and querying protein perturbation landscapes across global sequence space.
items.summary_zh: RegimeFormer 与 RegimeAtlas 汇整并索引生命树上 202,556,313 条非冗余蛋白序列，以保留多样性的 100 万蛋白子集提供高分辨率训练与推理。它从深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信度和进化约束中识别蛋白扰动状态，并称其状态条件化可改善未见蛋白、未见家族和低同源性情形的替换预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超大规模蛋白扰动表征可为变异效应、蛋白工程及药物反应建模提供共享先验。摘要的多项规模和性能主张仍应结合数据许可、训练细节与独立评测核验。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白语言模型能够在大规模上组织序列和结构信息，但对于蛋白如何响应突变的全局表征仍然缺失。我们提出 RegimeFormer，一个大型蛋白扰动模型，并配套提出 RegimeAtlas；后者通过协调并索引生命树上的 202,556,313 条非冗余蛋白序列构建。一个保留多样性的 100 万蛋白子集提供高分辨率训练和推理层，其中 995,995 个蛋白在 407,048,356 个残基上产生残基级摘要，并可按需获得特异替换预测。在实验性深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信度和进化约束中，RegimeFormer 识别出可重复的蛋白级扰动状态，这些状态组织残基脆弱性、适应性和预测不确定性。在未见蛋白、未见家族和低同源性评估下，状态条件化改善了特异替换预测，其中相对增益最大。RegimeFormer 导出的分子先验还进一步改善了下游转录组和药物反应建模。RegimeFormer 与 RegimeAtlas 共同提供了一个可扩展框架，用于在全球序列空间中绘制、预测和查询蛋白扰动景观。
items.author_line: Siyuan Ma, Yi Chai, Yi Wu, Qixin Zhang, Yajing Yuan, Kanglu Zhao, Zhikang Chen, Haowei Wang, Shuying Cao, Xiaolei Yu, Xiangfei Han, Yun Liu, Yang Liu, Tingting Zhu, Dacheng Tao

items.title: Tyrosine phosphorylation and the inhibitory C-terminal SAM domain moderately affect transient interactions in a EphA2 cytoplasmic fragment in solution: A combined experimental and molecular modeling study.
items.abstract_or_text: Eph receptors, the largest family of receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs), orchestrate diverse developmental processes, including axon guidance, tissue patterning, and cell positioning, while also contributing to adult functions such as synaptogenesis and tissue homeostasis. Proteolytic cleavage of Eph receptors by neurodegeneration-associated proteases generates a membrane-detached intracellular region (ICR) fragment whose structural organization and signaling remain poorly understood. Here, we characterize a model for such a fragment from EphA2 and discover that the juxtamembrane region, the kinase domain, and the C-terminally linked sterile alpha motif (SAM) domain comprise a configurational ensemble of domain contacts and orientations which inhibit the intermolecular interactions and tyrosine cross-phosphorylation. Recombinant EphA2 ICR expressed in E. coli retains catalytic activity and undergoes autophosphorylation at multiple tyrosine residues which have previously been identified in eukaryotic systems. Phosphorylation weakens intramolecular interactions, as measured by microscale thermophoresis, indicating a phosphorylation-dependent remodeling of the ICR. While AlphaFold2-Multimer (AF2M) and Alphafold3 (AF3) predictions as well as available crystal structures provide only limited insight into these configurational states, coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations using the Martini 3 force field reveal highly dynamic and predominantly transient interactions between the kinase and SAM domains that cluster at two discrete regions on the kinase surface. NMR spectroscopy of isotopically labeled EphA2 SAM suggests non-canonical intramolecular contacts that preserve the canonical SAM interaction interface for binding of partner proteins. Addition of the SHIP2 SAM domain promotes formation of the canonical EphA2 and SHIP2 SAM complex while also revealing previously unrecognized interactions of the kinase domain on the SHIP2 SAM domain. Collectively, these findings establish the EphA2 ICR as a dynamic, phosphorylation-responsive signaling module in which transient intramolecular interactions regulate accessibility of several interfaces for binding. Thus, the proteolytically released EphA2 intracellular fragment is likely to have distinct characteristics in cancer and neurodegenerative disease, compared to the membrane bound form in the full receptor.
items.summary_zh: 研究结合重组蛋白、微量热泳、NMR、AlphaFold2-Multimer、Alphafold3 和 Martini 3 粗粒化分子动力学，解析被蛋白水解释放的 EphA2 胞内区。结果指出连接膜近区、激酶域和 C 端 SAM 域形成动态接触集合；磷酸化会削弱分子内作用，而 SHIP2 SAM 可形成经典复合物并显示额外激酶域相互作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多种实验与模拟证据共同描绘了一个磷酸化响应的动态信号模块，提示肿瘤和神经退行性病变中游离 EphA2 片段可能有别于膜结合受体。结构预测对瞬态状态的局限也被作者明确指出；该研究并非 AI 方法学本身。
items.abstract_zh: Eph 受体是受体酪氨酸激酶（RTKs）中最大的家族，协调轴突导向、组织模式形成和细胞定位等多种发育过程，同时也参与突触发生和组织稳态等成年期功能。与神经退行性疾病相关的蛋白酶对 Eph 受体进行蛋白水解切割，会产生一个脱离膜的胞内区（ICR）片段，而其结构组织和信号传导仍知之甚少。我们在此表征来自 EphA2 的此类片段模型，并发现近膜区、激酶结构域和 C 端连接的 sterile alpha motif（SAM）结构域构成一个由结构域接触和取向组成的构象集合，它们抑制分子间相互作用和酪氨酸交叉磷酸化。在 E. coli 中表达的重组 EphA2 ICR 保持催化活性，并在多个此前已在真核系统中鉴定的酪氨酸残基上发生自磷酸化。微量热泳测量显示，磷酸化会削弱分子内相互作用，表明 ICR 发生磷酸化依赖的重塑。尽管 AlphaFold2-Multimer（AF2M）和 Alphafold3（AF3）的预测以及现有晶体结构只能对这些构象状态提供有限见解，采用 Martini 3 力场的粗粒化分子动力学模拟揭示了激酶和 SAM 结构域之间高度动态、以瞬态为主的相互作用，它们聚集于激酶表面的两个离散区域。对同位素标记 EphA2 SAM 的 NMR 光谱表明，存在非经典的分子内接触，但仍保留用于结合伴侣蛋白的经典 SAM 相互作用界面。加入 SHIP2 SAM 结构域可促进经典 EphA2-SHIP2 SAM 复合物形成，同时也揭示了激酶结构域与 SHIP2 SAM 结构域此前未识别的相互作用。总体而言，这些发现确立 EphA2 ICR 是一个动态、对磷酸化有响应的信号模块，其中瞬态分子内相互作用调控多个结合界面的可及性。因此，相较于全长受体中的膜结合形式，经蛋白水解释放的 EphA2 胞内片段在癌症和神经退行性疾病中可能具有不同特征。
items.author_line: Shrestha, P., Sahoo, A. R., Iannucci, M., Willard, B., Buck, M.

items.title: Interpreting Latent Protein Language Model Features with Geometric Annotations
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models (pLMs) encode information about protein sequences which enable downstream tasks such as structure prediction, but their internal representations are not well understood. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising tool to disentangle latent pLM representations into interpretable features, but existing annotation pipelines largely rely on protein-level annotations derived from database labels and LLM annotations of top activating sequences. Such annotations can overlook the localized residue-level and geometric patterns encoded by sparse features. We introduce an automated and scalable method for interpreting SAE features in ESM-2 by using geometrically inspired features of the protein C_α backbone. Across ESM-2 8M layers, an FDR-controlled discovery analysis shows that local geometry is significantly associated with many SAE features, with varying levels of predictive strength, expanding coverage beyond database and sequence-based methods. In particular, geometry can distinguish SAE features sharing the same database annotation, revealing substructure within known biological labels. A significant portion of SAE features activate on unannotated metagenomic protein sequences enabling us to use our SAE annotations to better understand these sequences. In addition, ablation experiments at the level of contact prediction show that removing found geometric features shifts ESM-2's predicted contact maps in the direction of the descriptor. This provides a robust method of annotating proteins activated within SAE neurons at a residue level, providing a bridge between mechanistic interpretability and structural biology.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以蛋白 C_α 主链的几何特征自动、可扩展地注释 ESM-2 中稀疏自编码器特征。跨 ESM-2 8M 各层的 FDR 控制分析显示，局部几何与许多 SAE 特征显著相关；接触预测消融还显示，移除已发现的几何特征会使预测接触图朝相应描述符方向改变。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将蛋白语言模型隐特征联系到残基级几何模式，有助于把机制可解释性推进到结构生物学问题。摘要仅报告了相关、注释和消融结果，尚不能将这些特征直接视作因果生物机制。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白语言模型（pLMs）编码蛋白序列信息，从而支持结构预测等下游任务，但人们对其内部表征知之甚少。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）为将潜在 pLM 表征解缠为可解释特征提供了有前景的工具，但现有注释流程在很大程度上依赖从数据库标签得出的蛋白质级注释，以及对最高激活序列的 LLM 注释。此类注释可能忽略稀疏特征所编码的局部残基级和几何模式。我们引入一种自动且可扩展的方法，利用蛋白 C_α 主链的几何启发特征来解释 ESM-2 中的 SAE 特征。跨 ESM-2 8M 各层，FDR 控制的发现分析显示，局部几何与许多 SAE 特征显著相关，且预测强度各异，从而将覆盖范围扩展到数据库和基于序列的方法之外。特别是，几何信息能够区分共享同一数据库注释的 SAE 特征，揭示已知生物学标签中的子结构。相当一部分 SAE 特征在未注释的宏基因组蛋白序列上激活，使我们能够使用 SAE 注释更好地理解这些序列。此外，在接触预测层面的消融实验表明，移除所发现的几何特征会使 ESM-2 预测的接触图朝描述符所指方向改变。这为在残基水平上注释由 SAE 神经元激活的蛋白质提供了一种稳健方法，并在机制可解释性与结构生物学之间建立桥梁。
items.author_line: Siddharth Setlur, Djordje Mihajlovic, Darrick Lee

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Antifungal Drug Discovery Against WHO Critical-Priority Pathogens: Toward a WHO-Aligned, Selectivity-Integrated Discovery Pipeline
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence has demonstrated real power in medicinal chemistry generally, yet it remains almost entirely absent from actual antifungal drug development, a gap made more urgent by rising antifungal resistance and a drug pipeline that has produced almost no genuinely new chemical classes in two decades. Invasive fungal infections, rising antifungal resistance, and a critically depleted drug pipeline together constitute a public health emergency that recent burden estimates suggest rivals tuberculosis in annual mortality. Since 2022, the WHO Fungal Priority Pathogen List has offered a strategic plan for prioritizing resources; however, the use of artificial intelligence in the discovery of antifungals is still scattered, and even the most recent and extensive scoping review of the literature (106 primary studies) outlined existing applications but did not suggest how to unify them. This review concludes that the gap must be addressed by shifting the focus of antifungal AI research from two concepts to two principles: pathogen prioritization that is directly taken from the WHO list, and therapeutic selectivity that is considered a scored, quantitative constraint that is applied at every pipeline stage instead of as an afterthought when potential compounds are already identified. We are proposing a conceptual pipeline with 6 steps: pathogen stratification, AI-enabled target validation, generative molecular design, multi-objective optimization, forward ADMET and resistance predictions, and experimental prioritization. We operationalize this with two tools: a scored Priority-Selectivity Matrix, demonstrated here with a worked numerical example across five real antifungal targets, and a Stage-Specific AI Toolkit. We further provide a critical appraisal of the specific published tools that already exist in this space, HitList, Fung-AI, FungAMR, and a 2026 pooled CRISPRi screen, showing precisely where each stops short of an integrated, selectivity-first system, and we identify a structural blind spot largely absent from prior antifungal AI literature: the highest-value antifungal targets are integral membrane proteins, the exact protein class that current structure-prediction and docking models handle least reliably. Finally, we remark that all the antifungal agents developed in the last five years have been developed by traditional medicinal chemistry, not AI, so the regulatory process for an AI-generated antifungal has never been tested. This synthesis is designed to translate the scene of a series of disconnected computational demonstrations to a prioritized, discovery-focused, quantitatively assessed effort in the realm of antifungals.
items.summary_zh: 这篇综述提出面向 WHO 真菌重点病原体的抗真菌 AI 发现路线：病原体分层、AI 靶点验证、生成式分子设计、多目标优化、前瞻 ADMET 与耐药性预测，以及实验优先排序；并给出 Priority-Selectivity Matrix 和 Stage-Specific AI Toolkit。作者同时指出高价值靶点多为当前结构预测和对接最不可靠的整合膜蛋白。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把病原体优先级和治疗选择性明确置入抗真菌发现的各阶段，回应了耐药上升和创新化学类别不足的问题。该工作是概念性综述与数值示例，不应被解读为已经获得 AI 设计的抗真菌候选物或临床证据。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能已在广义药物化学中展示出真正的力量，但在实际抗真菌药物开发中仍几乎完全缺席；抗真菌耐药性的上升以及一个在二十年中几乎没有产生真正新化学类别的药物管线，使这一缺口更为紧迫。侵袭性真菌感染、不断上升的抗真菌耐药性和严重枯竭的药物管线共同构成公共卫生紧急状况；近期疾病负担估计表明，其年死亡率可与结核病相当。自 2022 年起，WHO 真菌重点病原体清单为资源优先配置提供了战略方案；然而，人工智能在抗真菌药发现中的应用仍然零散，即使最新且最广泛的文献范围综述（106 项原始研究）概述了现有应用，也未提出如何将它们统一起来。本综述认为，必须通过将抗真菌 AI 研究的重点从两个概念转向两个原则来解决这一缺口：直接取自 WHO 清单的病原体优先排序，以及被视为评分化、定量约束、在每个管线阶段实施的治疗选择性，而非在潜在化合物已被识别后才加以考虑。我们提出一条包含 6 个步骤的概念性管线：病原体分层、AI 赋能的靶点验证、生成式分子设计、多目标优化、前瞻性 ADMET 和耐药性预测，以及实验优先排序。我们用两种工具将其操作化：Priority-Selectivity Matrix——在五个真实抗真菌靶点上以计算示例展示——以及 Stage-Specific AI Toolkit。我们还对该领域已存在的特定已发表工具 HitList、Fung-AI、FungAMR 和一项 2026 年 pooled CRISPRi screen 进行了批判性评估，精确说明每一种工具在哪些方面尚未形成整合的、选择性优先的系统；并识别出既有抗真菌 AI 文献中大多缺失的一个结构盲点：最高价值的抗真菌靶点是整合膜蛋白，而这恰是当前结构预测和对接模型处理最不可靠的蛋白类别。最后，我们指出过去五年中开发的所有抗真菌药物均由传统药物化学开发，而非 AI，因此 AI 生成抗真菌药物的监管过程从未接受测试。这一综合旨在将一系列彼此脱节的计算演示，转化为抗真菌领域中经优先排序、以发现为中心且经过定量评估的工作。
items.author_line: Allan Francis Ssembuusi, Eloghosa Aisosa Nosa-Ihaza

review.note: 从完整候选集中选出 14 项质量分不低于 70 的工作；排序优先考虑与 AI × Chem 的贴合度、方法新意及摘要所述验证强度。均为预印本，结论仍待同行评议与独立复现。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Z.ai 将 GLM-5.3 以开放权重形式发布
breaking_news.summary_zh: Z.ai 通过公开帖文宣布 GLM-5.3 开放权重，提供模型权重与技术博客，并称其面向智能体编程和网络防御。开发者可下载、运行和定制该模型；具体能力仍应以独立评测和实际部署结果检验。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 前沿能力模型转为开放权重，会扩大评测、微调和本地部署的参与者范围，并可能重塑智能体编程与网络防御的工具生态。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Anthropic 报告智能体已参与跨机构实验自动化测试
breaking_news.summary_zh: Anthropic 在官方帖文中报告，配合 MHS 的智能体已在 Genentech 药物发现、Janelia 成像及 QuEra 量子硬件的早期测试中执行实验；其中激光稳定性据称从58%提高至99.3%。这些仍是机构披露的早期结果。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 若可复现，它表明智能体可进入实时纠错的湿实验与仪器控制，而非仅辅助分析；跨机构场景和量化指标使其值得重点追踪。
